name: Custom Elements for GeneratePress by DigitalMasteryPath
author: Digitalmasterypath

sections.description:
Custom Elements for GeneratePress by DigitalMasteryPath makes it easy to insert block-based content into the most useful GeneratePress hooks — without needing GP Premium or writing PHP.

What You Can Do
– Insert blocks into selected hook locations (like before content, after header, or footer)
– Target specific pages, posts, or show site-wide
– Use Gutenberg to design your content visually
– Center-align the primary navigation bar
– Lightweight and fast — built specifically for GeneratePress
– ✅ See examples in action:
– GeneratePress Hooks & Filters Blog Post
– Video Tutorial on YouTube
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Create a new “GP Hook” post and assign its hook location and visibility
  4. Optionally, center your primary nav from the Customizer
sections.faq:
Does this replace GeneratePress Premium’s Elements?

No — this provides a lightweight, block-based way to add custom layout positions using the most useful hooks. It’s ideal for those who want visual layout control without writing code.

Can I use it without GeneratePress Premium?

Yes — this plugin works with the free GeneratePress theme.
